notes.title: Update Alpha 1.3.5 released
notes.content:
Alpha 1.3.5 stable update log

The initial test from 1.2.2t test version to 1.3.4t monster Legion version has been completed. According to the opinions collected from the test, the following cumulative improvements are made.

Bug repair:
[list]
[*] fixed the problem that the item shortcut key cannot be used when the health value is 1
[*] fixed the problem that monsters that shouldn't drop life ball will still drop it
[*] fixed a scoring leak
[*] fixed that some shields could not be unlocked normally due to a data problem
[*] fixed the problem that the stage Abyss cannot enter the next level when the frame number is low
[*] fixed the problem that some users' difficulty displayed as garbled code in the final settlement interface
[/list]

Game improvement and adjustment:
[list]
[*] set the number of enemies according to the game mode, increase the number of enemies from Normal to Abyss mode, and restore the number of enemies and AI before Version 1.2.1 to Easy and Normal mode
[*] increase the type of health potion
[*] modify horn function to increase attack power for it
[*] adjust all enemy collider rules
[*] adjust the basic resource explosion rate to adapt to the current version
[*] there will be no supplies in the golden chest
[*] description of number of foes and integral rate of each difficulty added
[*] add night music at each stage
[*] add new stage daytime music
[*] modify the background sound of the Oracles Realm
[*] greatly adjust monster resistance
[*] new damage calculation mechanism
[*] greatly reduce the impact caused by ranged weapons
[*] adjust HP of foes under different mode
[*] increases the damage taken by players under Abyss mode
[*] strengthen bosses, adjust the experience value and score of bosses
[*] adjust rendering brightness of stage Forgotten Desert and Ice Heart
[*] adjust the probability of encountering bad weather at each level and adjust the black fog effect
[*] adjust the collider size of bat and spider foes
[*] adjust speed of Gary's Shoulder Charge skill
[/list]

notes.title: Update Alpha 1.2.2 released
notes.content:
Alpha 1.2.2 update log
Bug fixed:
[list]
[*] fixed the loss of collision blocks in 'Ice Heart' level
[*] fixed the "evil eye" can be used to swipe scores
[*] fixed the weather icon is still displayed at the 'Abyss' level
[*] fixed the spawn times of 'Envoy'
[/list]

Game improvement and adjustment:
[list]
[*] add tutorial level
[*] add specific description of the effect of armor, APS, helmet, backpack and mask
[*] elites and mutated foes will provide more experience points and scores
[*] adjust A01 basic data
[/list]

notes.title: Update Alpha 1.2.1 released
notes.content:
Alpha 1.2.1 update log
Bug fixed:
[list]
[*] fixed menu cannot be opened due to pressing menu key and disassembly key at the same time
[*] fixed HP will display as floating-point data in some special cases
[*] fixed the data disorder of perk menu
[*] fixed partial data overflow when character died
[*] fixed the loss of special effect texture of individual weapon elements
[/list]
Game improvement and adjustment:
[list]
[*] improve character roll, move and melee attack speed
[*] reduce the difficulty of stage windmill hill and foes configuration
[*] reduce the number of spike traps at stage windmill hill
[*] reduce the difficulty of crystal challenge
[*] adjust the difficulty of elite challenge, and gradually increase the difficulty according to the level
[*] adjust the difficulty of battle challenge, and gradually increase the difficulty according to the level
[*] adjust attack power of Long Sword
[*] adjust the overall attack ability of Sliver Dragon
[*] adjust the data curve of long sword weapons
[*] add description of map key(M) to Instruction menu
[/list]
